scope: Frozen fern RGB-only path diagnostic; 3 paths x 3 seeds x 30k
statistical_unit: Three paired seeds on one development scene; mean of per-seed scene means
limits: Descriptive sample SD only. One run per seed/path, coupled prior-cache/diagnostics differences and CUDA nondeterminism prevent causal or formal equivalence claims.

metric_protocol.psnr: -10 log10 per-image RGB MSE, then arithmetic image mean

historical_rgb_reference.caveat: Older source revision and one historical run; kept separate, not a fourth seed or within-source repeated-run variance estimate

acceptance.path_finding: RGB+ED zero path is lower in all 3 seed scene means on all 3 metrics; do not treat paths as empirically equivalent or infer isolated kernel causality
acceptance.quality: Uniform improves each seed scene mean against both controls, with one PSNR regression and one SSIM regression against RGB-only at view level
acceptance.baseline_policy: Use preselected RGB-only as main Vanilla baseline; preserve RGB+ED zero as matched depth-loss ablation. Report both, never choose the weaker reference per seed.
acceptance.research_limit: One development scene, 3 seeds, one run per seed/path; no formal equivalence, causal explanation or cross-scene success claim
acceptance.next: Continue Phase 2 on predetermined flower/leaves development scenes with fixed settings and the two controls; no reliability module. Separate scope and download approval required.
